The '''Melida/Daan Unified Congress Building''' was a structure built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Constructed during a rare [[Time/Legends|time]] of peace between the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] tribes, which had been at [[Melida/Daan Civil War|war]] with each other for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], the building only stood undamaged for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]], after which war was once again declared, and the building was bombed. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], when [[the Young]]&mdash;a faction composed of children from both tribes&mdash;[[Young–Elders War|ended]] the war and took over the government, they chose this building to host their [[Young advisory council|council]] meetings.

==Description==
The Melida/Daan Unified Congress Building was built in<ref name="JA6" /> [[Zehava]],<ref name="CSWE entry" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the<ref name="JA5">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}&mdash;Based on corresponding data for [[Melida/Daan system/Legends|Melida/Daan system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]].<ref name="JA6" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the building was heavily damaged&mdash;many of the [[Window/Legends|windows]] were gone, and a large portion of the roof was missing, leaving the building open to the effects of weather. In addition, there was much debris lying around, including small debris, and larger columns and beams. During [[the Young]]'s occupation of the building, it had a large, round table.<ref name="JA6" />

==History==
[[File:MelidaDaan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The building was located on Melida/Daan.]]
By [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]]<ref name="date" /> the Melida/Daan Unified Congress Building was constructed on Melida/Daan. It served as a government building during a rare break in the ongoing [[Melida/Daan Civil War|civil war]] between the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] tribes, when the two warring factions attempted to rule the planet together. Three years later, the peace fell apart, and after war again broke out, the building was [[Bomb/Legends|bombed]].<ref name="JA6" />

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> [[the Young]]&mdash;a faction of both Melida and Daan children&mdash;ended the war when they started a [[Young–Elders War|new war]] against the combined Melida and Daan forces. After defeating them, the Young formed a new government and chose the building to host [[Young advisory council|advisory council]] meetings as a symbol of unity.<ref name="JA6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Melida/Daan Unified Congress Building appeared in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]'', written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[2000]].<ref name="JA6" /> It also received an entry in the reference work ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in [[2008]]. ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' contradicts ''The Uncertain Path'' by saying that it "survived three years of fighting,"<ref name="CSWE entry" /> while ''The Uncertain Path'' states that the building stood for three years in peacetime before being damaged when the war resumed.<ref name="JA6" />
